title: Last weekend
description: Describe what you did last weekend using the Past Simple.

introduction.headline: Describe last weekend
introduction.body: Practise Past Simple verbs and time expressions like last weekend and on Saturday.
introduction.bodyIt: Esercitati con il Past Simple e con espressioni come last weekend e on Saturday.
objectives: Use last weekend and on Saturday
Describe free-time activities in the past

vocabulary.example: Last weekend I stayed at home.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il weekend scorso sono rimasto a casa.

vocabulary.example: I met my friends on Saturday.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Ho incontrato i miei amici sabato.

vocabulary.example: We watched a film at home.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Abbiamo guardato un film a casa.

options: Last weekend I met my friends.
Last weekend I meet my friends.
Last weekend I meeting my friends.
Last weekend I meets my friends.
exercises.answer: Last weekend I met my friends.
exercises.explanation: Use Past Simple (met) with last weekend.

exercises.prompt: We ____ a film on Saturday evening.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: We ____ a film on Saturday evening.
exercises.explanation: The Past Simple of watch is watched.

summary: Past Simple for finished free time
review.tip: Write three sentences about last weekend using met or watched.
